paragraphs.text: The kiln retrofit was a resounding success: across 40 firing cycles in September 2026, gas consumption fell from 620 to 410 cubic meters per tonne of finished tile, while daily output remained at 18 tonnes and the rejection rate held steady at 2 percent.
